name: Boku ga Watashi ni Natta Wake ~Josou Keikaku~
original_name: ボクがワタシになった理由～女装計画～
source:
Aoi lost his parents when he was a kid. He has been living with his older sister, Mashiro, since then. But their relationship is somewhat odd. Aoi feels happy to be teased by Mashiro. Mashiro also loves to tease Aoi. One day, Mashiro orders Aoi to transfer to Mashiro's school under the disguise of a girl. Her school is a famous boarding girls' school where rich girls enter. Aoi successfully joins them without knowing Mashiro's intention. But days later, a girl finds that Aoi is actually a boy...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
葵年幼时失去父母，此后一直与姐姐真白共同生活。然而，姐弟二人的关系有些奇怪：葵喜欢被真白捉弄，真白也非常享受欺负葵。一天，真白命令葵男扮女装，转入自己所在的学校。那是一所著名的寄宿制女子学校，学生大多出身富裕家庭。葵在不了解真白真实意图的情况下顺利混入学校，但几天后，一名少女发现了他其实是男生…

[摘自ErogeShop]
